title: Make browser search, waits and form input faster while handling CDP disconnects safely.
changes: Prefilter role and text candidates before expensive browser layout work, preserving ARIA and visible-text fallback semantics.
Combine browser-wait condition and observed URL reads while keeping independent before/after URL, DNS and SSRF checks.
Combine field focus and clear into one internal CDP action before native text insertion, preserving input/change events, password redaction and read-back verification.
Fail outstanding browser event waiters immediately after CDP disconnect and clear pending synchronous WebSocket send failures.
Keep existing browser tool schemas, authorization and loopback-only CDP policy. Validate with isolated Chrome and full runtime regressions before release.
